citation.title: The potential risk of ventilator-induced lung injury from five different PEEP titration techniques in ARDS

provenance.quote: Patients aged 18 years or older who had moderate to severe ARDS according to the Berlin classification were included in the study.
All patients were ventilated in the supine position on a Hamilton G5 ventilator (Hamilton Medical, Bonndorf, Switzerland) equipped with a dual-limb circuit and heated humidifier.

comparator_verbatim.value: The study compared five PEEP titration methods: best respiratory system compliance, best lung compliance, lowest PEEP with Ptp_ee_direct ≥ 0 cmH2O, PEEP with Ptp_ei_derived ≤ 25 cmH2O, and EIT-based balance of overdistension and collapse.

provenance.quote: Our primary objective was to compare OP values determined by five distinct methods: 1. Best CRS 2. Best lung compliance (CL) 3. Lowest PEEP yielding Ptp_ee_direct ≥ 0 cm H2O 4. PEEP corresponding to an upper limit of elastance derived end-inspiratory transpulmonary pressure (Ptp_ei_derived) ≤ 25 cm H2O 5. EIT-based balance of regional overdistension and collapse.

crossover_order.value: All five methods were determined from the same decremental PEEP titration (from 20 to 8 cmH2O in 2 cmH2O steps) following a recruitment maneuver.

provenance.quote: A recruitment maneuver followed by decremental PEEP titration was performed.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS: all patients had moderate to severe ARDS per Berlin definition. Obesity: mean BMI 23.62 kg/m2, below 30. Timing: not reported relative to intubation/ICU admission. Ptp targets: study applied both direct Ptp_ee (≥0 cmH2O) and elastance-derived Ptp_ei (≤25 cmH2O) strategies.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with known clusters. Unique cohort from Ramathibodi Hospital, Bangkok; no shared registration, enrolment dates, or centres identified in COHORTS.md.
unclear_items: Ptp_ee_direct for ptp_ee_zero arm reported as median 0.4 cmH2O with IQR (0.6, 1.0) which is inconsistent (lower IQR bound exceeds median). Recorded as reported; possible typographical error.
Ptp_ei_derived and Ptp_ee_direct values for ptp_ei_limit arm not reported in text; may be in Figure 4 but not extracted (estimation from figure not allowed).
Omnibus test for OP across five methods (p=0.001) is described as one-way ANOVA in sample size section but repeated-measures ANOVA elsewhere. Test used recorded as one-way ANOVA.
Co-interventions: tidal volume target not explicitly stated; only recorded tidal volume (6.2 mL/kg PBW) reported.
Timing of intervention relative to intubation/ICU admission not reported; timing_subgroup coded as unclear.
SpO2/FiO2 pre/post-RM reported for whole cohort; recorded under arm 'cohort' added to arms array.
Full publication language: inferred as English from journal publication; no explicit language statement.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Study not designed to assess clinical outcomes; final PEEP determined by attending physicians. EIT overdistension correlated with peak airway pressure (r=0.67, p<0.001) and elastance-derived lung stress (r=0.48, p<0.001). Ptp_ee_direct associated with zero lung collapse on EIT was 5.15 cmH2O (1.90, 6.70). Median EIT overdistension across all measurements was 12% (2, 23). Paco2 and other Table 1 values recorded in additional_baseline.
